messages:
Iris Chen: Hi everyone, Iris here (infra). First day questions about security onboarding: 1) I got a phishing sim notice but my laptop is on backorder. Do I need to enroll my personal Windows laptop? 2) How do I check BitLocker status quickly? 3) Is VPN required before I can access internal repos?

Dana (People Ops): welcome Iris! :wave: You do not need to enroll a personal device. Request a loaner via the facilities form and we will exempt you from the phish sim until you have a managed device. Security Basics + Data Handling are required within 72h.

Owen IT: @Iris - quick BitLocker check in Admin PowerShell:
```
manage-bde -status C:
```
If it says "Protection On" you9re encrypted. If "Off" we can push BitLocker or provide a loaner. For VPN: you can request temporary VPN access from identity if you need internal-only repos, but we prefer to give repo access once on a company-managed machine for code-of-record access.

Iris Chen: ran `manage-bde -status` -> "Percentage Encrypted: 0%". I9ll request a loaner. If I enroll personal device, will corporate certificates be installed?

Owen IT: For personal devices we only offer a minimal policy (disk encryption + screen lock). No mail certs or SSO profiles unless you switch to full corporate enrollment.

Ravi InfoSec: MFA is required regardless of device. Also note: if you are on a loaner we include you in the phishing cohort; if on a personal device we mark as exempt. We log enrollment events for compliance. If you want hardware key support, register a YubiKey during identity setup.

PhishSimBot: User Iris Chen tentatively added to phishing cohort on 2026-07-15. Reply "loaner-request" to request exemption until managed device assignment.

Iris Chen: loaner-request. Also: any guidance for keeping personal VMs when using loaner? I have local dev VMs with credentials I9t want synced.

Dana (People Ops): Facilities can configure loaner with power adapter and privacy screen. Keep personal VMs separate; do not copy company secrets onto personal images. We9ll add you to the onboarding tracker and schedule identity/MFA invites. Welcome! :tada:

Facilities: Loaner request received for Iris Chen. Delivery/pickup options sent via form: https://redwood.intranet/facilities/loaner-form. Estimated delivery 2 business days after approval.
